correctness.rationale: Every one of 2^21 arc subsets is tested against the exact indegree/outdegree/acyclicity criterion. The face matching is checked as a DAG on all 2927 augmented faces and gives critical counts (24,54,17), with Morse Smith form 1^11 in degree four and zero degree-five differential. Independent direct field ranks agree. Every quotient face orbit has size seven; the signed quotient cellular boundaries satisfy d²=0, with Smith diagonals d1:1^2, d2:1^21,7, d3:1^68, d4:1^88,7,7, d5:1^20. Integer homology and rational C7-multiplicities follow by elementary chain homology and transfer. All exact computations are rerun by check.py.

Full text of the two most relevant mathematical articles and all accessible own ledger claims were checked for the asserted invariant. Unindexed equivalents remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: A natural prime-order regular cyclic tournament lies outside the transitive-tournament homotopy theorem. Exact quotient homology exhibits two 7-torsion classes in H3 even though the covering has torsion-free homology, an integral equivariant effect invisible to nonequivariant Betti numbers and not forced by a free sevenfold cover alone. The result classifies every integral orbit-space homology group and every rational rotation representation, making a complete finite benchmark rather than an arbitrary single numeric invariant.
